host_audit: SK2 report follows existing attribute setup and cap-only return, using the actual templated pointer, actual dynamic shared size and existing launch geometry.
The SK2 key includes all emitted template distinctions, physical dimensions, pmax, UV mode, PDL, geometry and tensor device. Only BF16 and FP32 output types are emitted, distinguished by OutBytes.
Small MoE report uses the same BIG predicate and exact kernel pointer as the existing launch. Actual effective compile flags identify the decoder-specific resource sample.
Reporting is disabled before original prepare work and enabled only after original tune, PIN_PICK, self-test and guards. Newly built modules inherit current arm state.
Mutexes protect dedup, counters and output; atomic fast checks stop reporting after exhaustion. Controls do not reset bytes or keys.
No added device synchronization, input copy, kernel launch, timing call, attribute setter, fallback, error-clearing call, process, network or harness access.
API failure statuses remain explicit and corresponding unavailable values are minus one. CUDA errors do not select a different computation path.

result_gate: Root owns the single private check and exact receipt/profile/log archival.
Require official correctness PASS before treating it as useful diagnostic evidence.
Interpret only retained, attributable resource records with successful query statuses; missing or overflowed coverage remains unknown.
Small-MoE M/grid/PDL and generation are first-sample context, not exhaustive shape coverage or checkpoint identity.
CL greater than one occupancy is block-only capacity; cluster capacity and achieved occupancy are unmeasured.
No public promotion or performance claim from this score. No automatic retry for missing logs.
limitations: CPU mocks do not compile CUDA, validate CUDA capture behavior, establish actual function resources or prove GPU correctness.
Host logging can add eager/capture overhead; source preservation does not establish identical cubins or unchanged timing.
Read-only attributes cannot establish stalls, dynamic spill traffic, serialization absence or a future speedup mechanism.
The parent can emit additional output; a 10240-byte diagnostic cap does not guarantee that every line survives the official 16000-character tail.
Fresh unchanged tuning may choose a different specialization from the earlier public run.
